subject: npmx Weekly #25
headline: npmx Weekly #25
intro: Exciting updates and community highlights are here! Dive into the latest version enhancements, significant improvements in Module Federation, and engaging community events.

topics.title: Release of Version 0.17.0
topics.summary: The release of version 0.17.0 brings essential features and fixes to the npmx.dev platform, including color-bridge data anomalies and UI improvements, all aimed at enhancing user experience.

topics.title: Module Federation Updates
topics.summary: The new Module Federation 2.8.0 introduces a 54% size reduction for the official Vite plugin, improving efficiency and usability for developers across the ecosystem.

topics.title: Community Events in Berlin
topics.summary: Local contributors are organizing a series of community events in Berlin, offering opportunities for networking, collaboration, and vibrant discussions among tech enthusiasts.
